brief:
Heavy rainfall swept across Gaza on Friday morning as the winter season begins, Shehab Wire reported, worsening conditions for thousands of displaced people sheltering in deteriorating tents that offer little protection from cold and rainwater.

The downpour struck as displaced residents face inadequate shelter across the territory, with many housed in makeshift encampments vulnerable to weather exposure during the coming months.

title: Heavy rains compound suffering of displaced Palestinians in Gaza
